statements.text: In file USD01-12/19/2026-ESTT.I, Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar requested a transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds, and this request was received on 15-09-2026.
statements.quote: Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru, has requested transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds (Flag A), as his wife is working as Junior Assistant in the School Education Department at Vijayawada. The request was received on 15-09-2026.

statements.text: The proposed transfer would increase the total transfers in the Senior Assistant category to 19, representing 15.8% of the cadre strength and exceeding the ceiling.
statements.quote: 18 transfers have already been effected in the Senior Assistant category against a cadre strength of 120, i.e. 15%, and the present proposal would take it to 19 (15.8%); (c) one vacancy exists at Vijayawada.

statements.text: The note proposes that the Deputy Secretary may approve the transfer because the Secretary is on leave.
statements.quote: As the Secretary is on leave, the Deputy Secretary may kindly approve the transfer, and draft orders are put up for approval (DFA).

statements.text: According to Standing Order No.2/2020 of the Department, requests received outside the period of relaxation must be kept pending for consideration during the next general transfers.
statements.quote: As per para (e) of Standing Order No.2/2020 of this Department (Flag B), requests received outside the period of relaxation shall be kept pending for consideration during the next general transfers.
